boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named UAH spaces for studying, making, viewing art, meeting, and taking a break, each supported by a direct university source.

cards.title: M. Louis Salmon Library
cards.subtitle: UAH campus · 4700 Holmes Ave.
cards.notes: Start here when your group needs a flexible campus base: the library combines research help, group rooms, specialty labs, A/V areas, and printing.
cards.short_summary: A central academic building with several kinds of student workspaces.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH says Salmon Library supports students with reference assistance, instruction, group study rooms, A/V areas, printing, specialty labs, and more.
cards.source_title: Salmon Library | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Use during library operating hours; particular services and rooms may have separate rules.

cards.title: Book a Salmon Library study room
cards.subtitle: M. Louis Salmon Library
cards.notes: Reserve a room for a focused group session, then collect it at User Services with matching photo ID; walk-ups are first come, first served.
cards.short_summary: Bookable group and smaller study rooms with practical collaboration equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: The library lists five group study rooms and eight smaller rooms; group rooms include a table, chairs, whiteboard, computer, and wall-mounted monitor.
cards.source_title: Library Study Rooms | UAH Library
cards.access_notes: Reservations require a UAH email; checkouts are up to three hours, with renewal only if nobody is waiting.

cards.entity_name: M. Louis Salmon Library Sensory Space
cards.title: Take a reset in the Sensory Space
cards.subtitle: M. Louis Salmon Library
cards.notes: Use this quiet, semi-private room for a calm break from study or research; take a door pass, keep voices low, and leave supplies in place.
cards.short_summary: A regulated room for sensory regulation, relaxation, meditation, or stretching.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH describes the Sensory Space as a quiet and semi-private environment for regulation, relaxation, meditation, stretching, and other calming activities.
cards.source_title: M. Louis Salmon Library: Sensory Space | UAH Library
cards.access_notes: For current UAH students, faculty, and staff; maximum eight people, with visits normally limited to one hour.

cards.entity_name: M. Louis Salmon Library MultiMaker Lab
cards.title: Make and rehearse at the MultiMaker Lab
cards.subtitle: M. Louis Salmon Library
cards.notes: Plan a creation session for a presentation, audio, video, or prototype, and check the lab’s equipment and reservation guidance before arriving.
cards.short_summary: A library creation space for making, recording, and presentation practice.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH says the MultiMaker Lab provides equipment, software, and space for students, faculty, and researchers to create, record, or practice presentations and media.
cards.source_title: M. Louis Salmon Library MultiMaker Lab Policy | UAH Library
cards.access_notes: Lab computers are available to current UAH students, faculty, and staff; equipment and room use follow library policies.

cards.title: See what is showing in Salmon Library Gallery
cards.subtitle: First floor of M. Louis Salmon Library
cards.notes: Build in a short art stop while you are already in the library: the gallery sits by the coffee shop and hosts changing campus-connected shows.
cards.short_summary: An open-plan first-floor gallery integrated into the library’s daily flow.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH identifies Salmon Library Gallery as a first-floor, open-plan space next to the coffee shop that presents group shows and BA Exit Shows.
cards.source_title: Salmon Library Gallery | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Exhibitions change; check the gallery or UAH arts listings before making a special trip.

cards.title: Pair a study block with Student Success Center help
cards.subtitle: First floor of M. Louis Salmon Library
cards.notes: Use the center when a course calls for more structure: ask about tutoring, academic coaching, PASS, or writing tutoring alongside your study plan.
cards.short_summary: An academic-support center located inside Salmon Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH lists peer-assisted study sessions, academic coaching, content tutoring, online tutoring, and writing tutoring among the Student Success Center’s programs.
cards.source_title: Success Spots at UAH | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: The cited UAH page places the center on Salmon Library’s first floor; confirm current service availability before visiting.

cards.title: Take a game-room study break
cards.subtitle: Charger Union
cards.notes: When you need to step away from coursework, head to the Game Room for pool or table tennis, then return to your work with a clearer head.
cards.short_summary: A Charger Union recreation room for pool and table tennis.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH says students can play pool or table tennis on the Game Room’s tables when taking a break from studying.
cards.source_title: Charger Union | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Located in the Charger Union; facility hours and any activity availability can vary.

cards.title: Check the CU Theater calendar
cards.subtitle: Charger Union
cards.notes: Watch for a campus presentation or Cinema Sunday showing in this purpose-built theater; confirm the event listing and entry details before you go.
cards.short_summary: A 332-seat campus theater used for presentations and movies.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH describes the CU Theater as a 332-seat venue with a 28-foot screen and Dolby surround sound, used for presentations and Cinema Sunday movies.
cards.source_title: Charger Union | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Programming and admission conditions depend on the individual event; consult its listing.

cards.title: Meet on the Theater Bridge
cards.subtitle: Between Charger Union and CU Theater
cards.notes: Use the bridge’s tables and chairs as a practical meet-up point before an event or as a short outdoor-adjacent pause between campus errands.
cards.short_summary: A furnished connector between the union, theater, and Greenway.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH says the Theater Bridge connects the Charger Union and CU Theater, crosses over the Greenway, and has tables and chairs for students to hang out.
cards.source_title: Charger Union | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Access follows Charger Union and event-area operations; use the route without blocking pedestrian traffic.

cards.title: Visit Union Grove Gallery between classes
cards.subtitle: UAH campus
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition or arrange a visit for this historic gallery, then spend time with student installations, traditional shows, or campus events.
cards.short_summary: A restored historic building used for art exhibitions, meetings, and events.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH says Union Grove Gallery has continuously served as an art gallery since the 1970s and also hosts campus meetings, events, traditional exhibitions, and graduating student exit shows.
cards.source_title: Union Grove Gallery | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: UAH lists weekday-afternoon and appointment access; verify exhibition and visitor details before going.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-purchase activities at UAH and around Huntsville, each supported by a current public source.

cards.title: Settle in at Salmon Library
cards.subtitle: UAH campus
cards.notes: Meet in the library lobby, check in if you are a guest, then choose a floor to read, study, or catch up between classes.
cards.short_summary: A campus library hang with no charge to enter.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH states that community members may come to Salmon Library to read or study and that there is no charge to enter.
cards.source_title: Non-UAH Patrons: Community, Local Education, and Guest Access at the M. Louis Salmon Library
cards.access_notes: Guests check in at the User Services Desk; guest entry is from opening until 8 p.m. or 15 minutes before closing, whichever is earlier.

cards.title: Browse the physical collection
cards.subtitle: M. Louis Salmon Library, UAH
cards.notes: Pick a shelf or map case together and browse print books, journals, maps, or special collections without checking anything out.
cards.short_summary: An in-building browse session using UAH’s print collection.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH says community members without guest access may view the library’s physical books, journals, maps, and special collections, with no charge to enter.
cards.source_title: Non-UAH Patrons: Community, Local Education, and Guest Access at the M. Louis Salmon Library
cards.access_notes: Use materials in the building and follow library and campus policies; guests must check in at the User Services Desk.

cards.title: Look up a government document
cards.subtitle: M. Louis Salmon Library, UAH
cards.notes: Use the special kiosk to pull up a government document, then compare what you find and save a topic for a later research session.
cards.short_summary: A focused research stop using the library’s public government-documents kiosk.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH says community members without guest access can use a special kiosk at Salmon Library to look up government documents, and entry is free.
cards.source_title: Non-UAH Patrons: Community, Local Education, and Guest Access at the M. Louis Salmon Library
cards.access_notes: Ask library staff for government-documents kiosk information; guests must check in at the User Services Desk.

cards.title: Ride the Friday Night UAH Shuttle
cards.subtitle: Charger Village, Central Campus, North Campus, and off-campus stops
cards.notes: Bring a valid UAH student ID and use the Friday evening route to ride together between campus, Target, Walmart, and Bridge Street Centre.
cards.short_summary: A student-ID ride for reaching campus and nearby stops on Friday evenings.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH states that students ride the Friday Night UAH Shuttle free with a valid student ID.
cards.source_title: Transportation
cards.access_notes: The route runs Fridays except holidays; UAH lists a 5:00 p.m. start at Charger Village and a 10:10 p.m. final return.

cards.title: Follow the Downtown Art Essentials Tour
cards.subtitle: Downtown Huntsville public-art sites
cards.notes: Download the self-guided tour resource, choose a few stops, and take a slow walking loop through the documented public artworks downtown.
cards.short_summary: A self-guided downtown public-art walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Arts Huntsville provides downloadable self-guided public-art tour resources and describes the Downtown Art Essentials Tour as a self-guided adventure in public places.
cards.source_title: Public Art Discovery Tours
cards.access_notes: Download the guide before leaving; this is a self-guided walk through public places.

cards.entity_name: Visitor Center's Lucky Duck Scavenger Hunt
cards.title: Find the Lucky Duck sculptures
cards.subtitle: Downtown Huntsville public-art sites
cards.notes: Get the clue card online and split up the hints as you look for Everett Cox’s bronze ducks near downtown public-art locations.
cards.short_summary: A free scavenger hunt built around named bronze duck sculptures.
cards.evidence_claim: Arts Huntsville calls the Visitor Center’s Lucky Duck Scavenger Hunt free and says participants can get clue cards online.
cards.source_title: Public Art Discovery Tours
cards.access_notes: Use the online clue cards and follow the self-guided route in public areas.

cards.title: Walk Aldridge Creek Greenway
cards.subtitle: Huntsville greenway route toward Ditto Landing
cards.notes: Choose a turnaround point before you start, then walk, bike, roll, or stroll beside the creek and regroup at the end.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost greenway outing along Aldridge Creek.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Huntsville lists Aldridge Creek Greenway among its trails and greenways and says walking, biking, rolling, or strolling on a City greenway has no cost.
cards.source_title: 5 free Huntsville resources for a stronger, healthier you
cards.access_notes: Use the greenway for walking, biking, rolling, or strolling; bring water and use care around changing weather.

cards.title: Stroll Flint River Greenway
cards.subtitle: Huntsville greenway along the Flint River
cards.notes: Plan a daylight walk with a friend and use the river setting as the reason to slow down, talk, and take a few photos.
cards.short_summary: A river-side greenway walk without an admission charge.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Huntsville lists Flint River Greenway among its trails and greenways and says walking, biking, rolling, or strolling on a City greenway has no cost.
cards.source_title: 5 free Huntsville resources for a stronger, healthier you
cards.access_notes: Use the greenway for walking, biking, rolling, or strolling; plan around daylight and weather conditions.

cards.title: Take a Wade Mountain Greenway walk
cards.subtitle: Huntsville trail and greenway network
cards.notes: Set an easy pace on the unpaved route, pause for a group photo, and turn back well before daylight or weather becomes a concern.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost, off-pavement greenway outing.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Huntsville identifies Wade Mountain Greenway as a hiking option and says its City greenways and trails can be used with no cost.
cards.source_title: 5 free Huntsville resources for a stronger, healthier you
cards.access_notes: The City describes this as a route to leave pavement behind; use suitable footwear and plan for daylight and weather.

cards.entity_name: Dr. Richard Showers, Sr. Splash Pad
cards.title: Cool off at the Showers Splash Pad
cards.subtitle: 4600 Blue Springs Road NW, Huntsville
cards.notes: Bring a towel, meet at the shaded benches, and use the splash pad during posted hours; nearby tables make an easy regrouping spot.
cards.short_summary: A city splash pad with explicitly free use.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Huntsville states that the Dr. Richard Showers, Sr. Splash Pad is free to use.
cards.source_title: Dr. Richard Showers, Sr. Splash Pad
cards.access_notes: The City lists current hours as Monday through Saturday, 10 a.m.–7 p.m.; anyone under 16 must be accompanied by a family member age 16 or older.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For

cards.title: Salmon Library Group Study Rooms

cards.evidence_claim: Salmon Library has five group study rooms seating four to eight; each includes a table, chairs, whiteboard, computer, and wall-mounted monitor.
cards.source_title: UAH Library Study Rooms

cards.title: Salmon Library Smaller Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: M. Louis Salmon Library
cards.notes: Use the smaller-room option for a contained work block; reserve with a UAH email or ask in the first-floor lobby about same-day walk-up availability.

cards.evidence_claim: Salmon Library has eight smaller study rooms in addition to its five group study rooms.

cards.title: Sensory Space

cards.title: Student Success Center

cards.evidence_claim: The Student Success Center, located on Salmon Library's first-floor north side, offers peer-led academic support through one-on-one and group sessions.

cards.short_summary: Collaborative learning areas inside the campus Conference Training Center.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH states that the Conference Training Center contains numerous collaborative learning spaces, along with Charger Cafe and Charger Brew.
cards.source_title: UAH Conference Training Center

cards.title: Charger Union Conference Room 220
cards.subtitle: Charger Union, Room 220
cards.notes: Plan a compact four-person work meeting here when a reservable room and presentation-ready connections would help your group stay organized.

cards.evidence_claim: Charger Union Room 220 is a small conference room with capacity for four; conference-room use includes flat-screen TVs, speakers, and laptop connections.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten UAH-documented symbols, rituals, and recurring campus practices that mark Charger identity.

cards.title: Shout the U-A-H battle cry
cards.subtitle: UAH Charger Lore
cards.notes: Listen for the school fight song at Charger gatherings, then join the U-A-H battle cry and blue-and-white refrain when it is performed.
cards.short_summary: UAH’s official fight song gives Charger spirit a distinct call-and-response moment.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH publishes its fight song, including the U-A-H battle cry and blue-and-white refrain, as a Charger tradition.
cards.source_title: Traditions | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: A school song rather than a separately ticketed attraction; attend an announced campus or athletics event where it is performed.

cards.title: Raise your voice for the Alma Mater
cards.subtitle: UAH Charger Lore
cards.notes: Learn the Alma Mater’s UAH-specific words before a ceremonial campus gathering so you can recognize the shared song when it is used.
cards.short_summary: The Alma Mater is UAH’s formal song of loyalty and praise.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH lists an Alma Mater with lyrics praising UAH and its community as part of its traditions.
cards.source_title: Traditions | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: A ceremonial school-song tradition; availability depends on the program for an announced campus event.

cards.title: Wear the electric blue and white
cards.subtitle: UAH Charger Lore
cards.notes: Use electric blue and white for a campus event or game day to connect with the colors UAH identifies as part of Charger identity.
cards.short_summary: The Charger name and electric blue-and-white palette tie UAH spirit to the region’s electricity history.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH says its athletics squads are called the Chargers in reference to the region’s electricity production and identifies electric blue and white as school hues.
cards.source_title: Traditions | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: School-identity practice; wear campus colors at public university events as appropriate.

cards.title: Spot Charger Blue at a campus event
cards.subtitle: UAH Charger Lore
cards.notes: Keep an eye out for Charger Blue at an announced athletic competition, tailgate, or student event and capture a respectful event photo.
cards.short_summary: Charger Blue is the campus mascot associated with UAH spirit events.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH identifies Charger Blue as a campus staple at tailgates, athletic competitions, and student events.
cards.source_title: Traditions | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Mascot appearances depend on the event schedule; follow event staff guidance for photos and interaction.

cards.title: Meet the Lancers
cards.subtitle: UAH Charger Lore
cards.notes: Look for a Lancer during an official university program and ask a practical campus question; they serve as UAH’s student ambassadors.
cards.short_summary: Lancers carry forward UAH’s ambassador tradition through campus representation.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH describes Lancers as official university ambassadors selected for academic excellence, communication skills, and passion for UAH.
cards.source_title: Traditions | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Lancers are encountered through official university programs and outreach; participation or availability varies by event.

cards.title: Make the UAH spirit hand sign
cards.subtitle: UAH Icons
cards.notes: Practice the two-hand U-A-H gesture before a Charger event, then use it in a group photo without blocking anyone’s view.
cards.short_summary: A two-hand sign turns the letters U, A, and H into a compact expression of Charger pride.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH says students use both hands to form U, A, and H as a way to embrace Charger pride.
cards.source_title: Traditions | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: An informal, no-equipment school-spirit gesture suitable for public campus events and photos.

cards.title: Recognize a UAH challenge coin
cards.subtitle: UAH Icons
cards.notes: If you receive or see a UAH challenge coin, note the achievement it recognizes and treat it as an honor token rather than a purchase item.
cards.short_summary: UAH adapts the challenge-coin honor tradition for a Huntsville community shaped by military and space work.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH says it gives its own challenge coins and connects the practice to Huntsville’s space and military industries.
cards.source_title: Traditions | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Coins are recognition tokens, not a standing public attraction; receipt depends on university achievement or recognition programs.

cards.title: See the UAH Letters change for campus festivities
cards.subtitle: Outside the Conference Training Center
cards.notes: Visit the UAH Letters outside the Conference Training Center to see their current look; check event guidance before taking part in any painting.
cards.short_summary: The large UAH Letters provide a changing visual marker for Homecoming and Greek Life festivities.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH states that the UAH Letters outside the Conference Training Center are commonly painted for festivities including Homecoming and Greek Life events.
cards.source_title: Traditions | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: View the outdoor letters from public campus areas; do not paint or alter them unless an authorized event expressly permits it.

cards.title: Watch for the ceremonial mace at Commencement
cards.subtitle: UAH Commencement tradition
cards.notes: At an official commencement ceremony, watch for the ceremonial mace in the academic procession and observe the ceremony’s seating and photo rules.
cards.short_summary: The ceremonial mace symbolizes UAH leadership and its determination to move forward.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH calls use of the ceremonial mace at Commencement a longstanding tradition representing university leadership and determination to keep moving forward.
cards.source_title: Traditions | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Visible only during official commencement programming; guest admission and venue rules are set for each ceremony.

cards.title: Join the annual ChargerCON gathering
cards.subtitle: UAH Signature Event
cards.notes: Check the current ChargerCON program for tournament, art-festival, and cosplay-contest details, then choose an activity that fits your interests.
cards.short_summary: ChargerCON is UAH’s recurring campus convention for gaming, pop culture, and trading-card communities.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH describes ChargerCON as its annual gaming convention, featuring video game tournaments, an art festival, and a cosplay contest.
cards.source_title: Signature Events | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Annual event; consult the current university program for date, venue, registration, and any activity-specific requirements.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of Alabama in Huntsville, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure, under-21-safe sequence for learning the UAH campus, finding a current welcome activity, and ending with a Huntsville walk if transportation works for you.

cards.title: 1. Check the Week of Welcome schedule
cards.subtitle: Start-of-semester campus programs
cards.notes: Use the official schedule to choose one social, educational, or informational program that fits your arrival time and gives you a reason to meet people.
cards.short_summary: Begin with a recurring campus-wide welcome program.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH describes Week of Welcome as a campus-wide set of programs and activities for new and returning students at the start of each semester.
cards.source_title: Week of Welcome | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: See the official schedule for current programs and locations.

cards.title: 2. Make Charger Union your first landmark
cards.subtitle: Campus hub for dining, study space, and events
cards.notes: Walk through the Charger Union after your first program. Use it to orient yourself to a central place for dining, studying, and student events.
cards.short_summary: Establish a practical campus meeting point.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH identifies the Charger Union as the heart of campus life, with dining, study spaces, and student events.
cards.source_title: Life at UAH | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Campus map lists Charger Union as CGU; check building access before entering.

cards.title: 3. Pause for a campus meal at Charger Café
cards.subtitle: Conference Training Center
cards.notes: Use a meal break to practice finding the Conference Training Center and decide which dining option suits your plan. Confirm menus and service before going.
cards.short_summary: Pair lunch with another easy navigation win.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH’s orientation schedule places Charger Café in the Conference Training Center and schedules lunch there.
cards.source_title: Charger Camp Guest Schedule | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Dining requires payment or an eligible campus dining account; verify current hours and menu.

cards.title: 4. Locate your library reset spot
cards.subtitle: M. Louis Salmon Library
cards.notes: Stop in to identify the help desk, group-study options, and MultiMaker Lab. Save the library contact so you can ask about current hours or room access later.
cards.short_summary: Find study support before classes accelerate.
cards.evidence_claim: Salmon Library offers research materials, reference assistance, group study rooms, and the MultiMaker Lab.
cards.source_title: Salmon Library | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: The library reports it is open to the public; verify current building and service hours online.

cards.title: 5. Take in Union Grove Gallery
cards.subtitle: Historic campus gallery and meeting hall
cards.notes: Walk over to see the building and check whether a current exhibition is open. Weekday-afternoon visits or an appointment are the published visitor options.
cards.short_summary: Add a historic arts stop to the campus loop.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH says Union Grove Gallery is a restored historic building used for art exhibitions, meetings, and events, and is open weekday afternoons and by appointment.
cards.source_title: Union Grove Gallery | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Visitor access is listed for weekday afternoons and by appointment; confirm the exhibition schedule.

cards.title: 6. Find the UAH Community Garden
cards.subtitle: Map-listed campus garden
cards.notes: Use the campus map to locate the garden, then look for Green Club information if you want to garden with others or ask about plot availability.
cards.short_summary: Identify a hands-on campus community resource.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH’s Green Club says students can garden with others or rent their own plot at the UAH Community Garden.
cards.source_title: Student Organizations | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Garden participation and plot availability should be confirmed with the Green Club.

cards.title: 7. Tour the University Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: UFC on the UAH campus map
cards.notes: Find the facility and note the indoor track, gymnasium, and group-fitness offerings. Bring your Charger Card and verify eligibility before planning a workout.
cards.short_summary: Learn where campus recreation happens.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH’s University Fitness Center lists a gymnasium, indoor track, cardiovascular equipment, and group fitness classes.
cards.source_title: University Fitness Center | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Membership and facility access rules apply; verify current access requirements and hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Robert E. James Black Box Theatre
cards.title: 8. Put the Black Box Theatre on your map
cards.subtitle: Map-listed venue near Morton Hall
cards.notes: Walk by the Robert E. James Black Box Theatre and save its location for a future performance. Check UAH Theatre’s current calendar before attending.
cards.short_summary: Locate a named campus performance venue.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH’s campus map lists the Robert E. James Black Box Theatre as a campus destination.
cards.source_title: Campus Map | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Performance access, dates, and ticket requirements vary; consult the current event listing.

cards.title: 9. Find Charger Park for a future game
cards.subtitle: Map-listed athletics destination
cards.notes: Make a daylight walk to Charger Park and note the route from central campus. Use the athletics schedule later to choose an appropriate event to attend.
cards.short_summary: Add a named athletics destination to your mental map.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH’s campus map lists Charger Park as a campus destination.
cards.source_title: Campus Map | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Facility access and event admission vary; check the current athletics schedule before returning.

cards.title: 10. If you have transportation, end at Big Spring Park
cards.subtitle: 200 Church Street, Huntsville
cards.notes: If you can travel there safely, finish with a daytime walk on the park’s walking path. Keep this as an optional off-campus stop rather than a required campus trip.
cards.short_summary: A simple downtown outdoor add-on.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Huntsville lists Big Spring Park at 200 Church Street with passive greenspace and a walking path.
cards.source_title: Find a Park | City of Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Plan transportation and visit during daylight; follow posted City park rules.
